scope: local source/real-Chromium reproduction only; NOT hosted acceptance. Hosted Management outcome and aggregate remain FAIL for the exact 82ff run.
root_cause: The continueRequest rejection handler captured closed/detached/canceled booleans before its 25ms wait, so lifecycle events (loadingFailed canceled, new Document request, frameNavigated/detach) queued behind the CDP command rejection were never seen; a genuinely cancelled intercepted request was classified as a live Invalid InterceptionId.
fix: scripts/lib/pinned-browser-bff-bearer.mjs: for Invalid InterceptionId only, poll (10ms steps, 1000ms bound) the request's current ordered facts (closed, or canceled with detach, or canceled while a different navigation loader was pending at failure time and became the frame's loader). No fixed-wait captured values. All other errors, and unproven cases, are recorded immediately/after the bound, then Fetch.failRequest as before.

reproduction.real_chromium_test: e2e/hosted-bff-streaming-transport.spec.ts: 'queued cancellation lifecycle arriving after Invalid InterceptionId rejection is still proven' (real CDP; only delivery of real Network/Page events to helper listeners is held until 80ms after the real continueRequest rejection, order preserved)
reproduction.old_head_814_82ff_helper: FAILED (Pinned BFF transport failures: Invalid InterceptionId) before fix
reproduction.fixed_head: passed in 3 consecutive full-spec runs (16/16 x2 plus the run that had one unrelated 814-test flake; 814 test then 4/4 repeats passed)

negatives_preserved: live abort then navigation (also with late lifecycle)
invalid live protocol id (also with late lifecycle)
native SSE incremental / no route.fetch buffering
caveats: One non-reproducible failure of the pre-existing 'exact 814' test occurred in one of 3 full runs; 4 isolated reruns passed. No hosted/provider/credential use.
